name: Jest & Testing
description: Unit testing, integration testing, TDD, test automation

lessons.title: Jest Basics & First Tests
lessons.theory: Testing kiểm tra code hoạt động đúng. Jest là framework test phổ biến nhất cho JavaScript. describe nhóm tests, it/test mô tả hành vi. expect + matchers kiểm tra kết quả.
keyPoints: describe() nhóm related tests, test/it() mô tả 1 behavior
expect(value).toBe(expected) cho strict equality
toThrow() test exceptions, toBeCloseTo() cho floating-point
lessons.exercise: Viết tests cho hàm: isPrime, factorial, fibonacci.

lessons.title: Matchers & Assertions chi tiết
lessons.theory: Jest cung cấp nhiều matchers cho mọi kiểu so sánh: object, array, string, truthy/falsy, exceptions. toEqual deep equality, toBe reference equality.
keyPoints: toBe: strict === reference equality
toEqual: deep comparison cho objects/arrays
toMatchObject: partial object matching, rất hữu ích cho API tests
lessons.exercise: Viết tests cho shopping cart: addItem, removeItem, calculateTotal.

lessons.title: Test Structure & Organization
lessons.theory: AAA pattern: Arrange (setup), Act (execute), Assert (verify). beforeEach/afterEach cho setup/teardown. beforeAll/afterAll chạy 1 lần cho toàn bộ suite.
keyPoints: AAA: Arrange (setup) → Act (execute) → Assert (verify)
beforeEach: fresh state cho mỗi test, tránh test coupling
Nested describe blocks cho related feature grouping
lessons.exercise: Viết test suite cho BankAccount class: deposit, withdraw, getBalance.

lessons.title: Mocking & Spying
lessons.theory: Mock thay thế real implementations. jest.fn() tạo mock function. jest.mock() mock cả module. jest.spyOn() spy trên existing method mà giữ implementation.
keyPoints: jest.fn() tạo tracked mock function
mockResolvedValue cho async mocks, mockRejectedValue cho errors
toHaveBeenCalledWith(args) verify mock được gọi đúng
lessons.exercise: Mock API client và test service layer với error handling.

lessons.title: Testing Async Code
lessons.theory: Test async: dùng async/await, hoặc return Promise. resolves/rejects matchers cho Promise assertions. Fake timers (jest.useFakeTimers) cho setTimeout/setInterval.
keyPoints: async/await trong test, expect().resolves/.rejects cho Promises
jest.useFakeTimers() điều khiển thời gian
jest.advanceTimersByTime(ms) nhảy forward qua setTimeout
lessons.exercise: Test WebSocket connection với mock, timeout, và reconnection.

lessons.title: Setup, Config & Coverage
lessons.theory: Jest config (jest.config.js): test environment, coverage thresholds, module aliases. --coverage đo coverage. Setup files cho global mocks. Snapshot testing cho UI.
keyPoints: coverageThreshold đảm bảo minimum coverage %
toMatchSnapshot() cho regression testing
setupFilesAfterSetup cho global test configuration
lessons.exercise: Config Jest cho project với aliases, coverage 80%, custom matchers.

lessons.title: Integration Testing
lessons.theory: Integration tests kiểm tra nhiều modules work together. Test API endpoints với supertest. Test database queries. Test middleware chains.
keyPoints: supertest(app) test HTTP endpoints đầy đủ
Chaining: .send() → .expect(status) → .expect(header)
Integration = test modules together, unit = isolated
lessons.exercise: Viết integration tests cho REST API: CRUD + auth + error handling.

lessons.title: Test-Driven Development (TDD)
lessons.theory: TDD cycle: RED (write failing test) → GREEN (write minimum code to pass) → REFACTOR (clean up). Tests drive design.
keyPoints: RED: viết test trước, chưa có code → test FAIL
GREEN: viết minimum code để test PASS
REFACTOR: clean code mà tests vẫn pass
lessons.exercise: TDD: xây dựng URL shortener từ scratch, test trước code sau.

lessons.title: Testing Strategy & Patterns
lessons.theory: Test pyramid: Unit (70%) → Integration (20%) → E2E (10%). Test doubles: Mock, Stub, Spy, Fake. Test isolation. Flaky test detection. CI/CD integration.
keyPoints: Test pyramid: Unit(70%) > Integration(20%) > E2E(10%)
Builder pattern cho test data factory
Custom matchers: expect.extend() cho domain-specific assertions
lessons.exercise: Thiết kế testing strategy cho e-commerce app: unit + integration + E2E.

lessons.title: CI/CD & Test Automation
lessons.theory: GitHub Actions chạy tests tự động trên mỗi PR. Parallel test execution. Test splitting cho CI nhanh. Mutation testing kiểm tra test quality.
lessons.code:
# .github/workflows/test.yml
name: Tests
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [18, 20]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: "npm"
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test -- --coverage --ci
      - uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}

  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps
      - run: npx playwright test
keyPoints: GitHub Actions: automated testing on every push/PR
Matrix testing: multiple Node versions in parallel
Codecov: track coverage trends over time
lessons.exercise: Setup CI pipeline: lint → unit tests → integration → E2E → deploy.

lessons.title: Property-Based & Contract Testing
lessons.theory: Property-based testing: define properties code MUST satisfy, generator creates random inputs. Contract testing: verify API producer/consumer agreements.
keyPoints: Property-based: define invariants, random inputs find edge cases
fast-check tự shrink failing cases đến minimal example
Contract tests: verify API shape between services
lessons.exercise: Viết property-based tests cho search, filter, và pagination functions.

lessons.title: Testing Architecture & Testing Trophy
lessons.theory: Testing Trophy (Kent C. Dodds): Static → Unit → Integration → E2E. Integration tests give best ROI. Test behavior not implementation. Avoid testing internals.
keyPoints: Test behavior (output), không test implementation (internals)
Integration tests give highest confidence per test
Avoid mocking everything — test with real dependencies when possible
lessons.exercise: Refactor test suite: xóa implementation tests, thêm behavior tests.
